_comment: Device advisories and the known-good firmware list, keyed by vendor:device.
This table ships almost empty ON PURPOSE. A firmware string that nobody has
verified on your own hardware is `unknown`, and nicscope reports `unknown` as
a warning, never as a pass. Fill `known_good_firmware` from your own campaign
notes, one entry for each version you measured and trust. That is the only
list that means anything for your measurement.
`revisions` keys on the PCI revision register, which is the silicon stepping.
It is read from /sys/bus/pci/devices/<bdf>/revision. A revision rule wins over

8086:15f2.name: Intel I225-LM
8086:15f2.note: Check the stepping. Early I225 silicon had a documented 2.5 Gbit/s link-stability problem that the later stepping addresses.

revisions.note: I225 A2 stepping. Known 2.5 Gbit/s link-stability problems. Prefer a B3 stepping or an I226 for a timing port.
I225 A3 stepping. Known 2.5 Gbit/s link-stability problems. Prefer a B3 stepping or an I226 for a timing port.
I225 B3 stepping. The 2.5 Gbit/s problem of the earlier steppings is addressed.
